fact: The NIA's Acting Executive Secretary said on 21 September 2025 that the National Identification System relies on its PPP partner Margins ID Group for technical expertise, system maintenance and card production, and that NIA alone could not repair equipment quickly under government procurement rules.

The analyst says NITA, mandated under Act 771 to provide core government IT infrastructure, runs the Government Cloud (G-Cloud) and the NITA Data Centre that ministries, departments and agencies can host on or bypass.
